description: Angular component for managing device credentials, including form handling, validation, and interaction with device credential models.

classes.name: DeviceCredentialsComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator for device credentials form.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates the form with provided device credentials data.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Propagates form value changes to external listeners.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for when form value changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the form is touched.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.

methods.name: credentialsTypeChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the credentials type, updating validators accordingly.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Sets validators based on the current credentials type.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a new secret and patches it into the specified form control.
